hints.title: Dimension Independence
hints.text: Row coordinates and column coordinates can be adjusted completely independently of each other.

hints.title: Target Row Assignment
hints.text: Sort the row coordinates r_0 <= r_1 <= ... <= r_{n-1}. Greedily assign the i-th rook to row i.

hints.title: Sum of Coordinate Shifts
hints.text: Compute total row moves sum(|r_i - i|) plus total column moves sum(|c_j - j|) after sorting column coordinates.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting row and column coordinates dominates the runtime.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Bipartite matching algorithm takes O(n^3) which is unnecessary given coordinate independence.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary memory to store sorted coordinates.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Decompose 2D Manhattan moves into two 1D independent greedy sorting alignments.
